name: ask-sales-v5-7-final-promotion-gold-2026-07-27
knowledgeSnapshot: frozen V5.7 generated operational Q&A, approved FAQ bundle, and governed registries at the runtime freeze commit

notes: Every source message ID is absent from every earlier Ask Sales evaluation dataset and runtime artifact at seal time.
The source window was chosen before runtime and weak, screenshot-dependent, peer-only, unresolved, and case-specific threads were excluded.
All 24 prompts have an exact source record in the frozen generated operational Q&A snapshot.
Four prompts intentionally require routing because the chatbot cannot perform the requested live action.
This dataset is invalidated as promotion evidence if V5.7 is tuned after any runtime output is inspected.

cases.question: A prospect asks why they do not receive residuals from their episode. What should I tell them?
cases.goldAnswer: ISTV does not make money from the client's episode and does not take any money the client may make from having the episode on the network.
requiredConcepts: ISTV does not make money from the episode
ISTV does not take money the client may make
forbiddenConcepts: ISTV takes a share of episode revenue

cases.question: An Operation CEO applicant has two businesses. Must the episode focus on only one of them?
cases.goldAnswer: No. The applicant may mention both businesses during the episode.

cases.question: I booked a Next Level CEO Call 1 but forgot to confirm that filming is at the Miami studio. Should I wait until Call 1 to mention it?
cases.goldAnswer: You may call the lead back after scheduling to make the Miami studio expectation clear. This is useful for confirming they are on board and avoiding a wasted call.
requiredConcepts: make the Miami studio expectation clear

cases.question: A prospect says weak authority is making them lose customers. May I ask what that is costing them?
cases.goldAnswer: Do not frame it with 'cost' or 'costing.' Ask how the problem could be negatively impacting their business instead; this does not permit directly asking for revenue.
requiredConcepts: ask how it negatively impacts the business
forbiddenConcepts: ask for an exact dollar loss

cases.question: Can someone who owns a Verizon franchise qualify, or are all franchise applicants disqualified?
cases.goldAnswer: A franchise owner may qualify, while a franchise manager does not qualify on that basis. Normal fit and qualification checks still apply to the owner.

cases.question: An author has no formal company, but has a book website and physical books that are selling. Can they qualify for America's Authors if the book is about history rather than business?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. An author may qualify without a formal business when the book has a website and physical copies that are selling; the book does not have to be about business. Normal fit checks still apply.
requiredConcepts: may qualify without a formal business

cases.question: A dial-out lead hung up as soon as I said Inside Success TV but never said STOP or asked not to be contacted. Should I add them to opt-outs?
cases.goldAnswer: No. A hang-up alone is not an opt-out. Add the lead to opt-outs only when they explicitly request no further contact, such as saying STOP or 'do not contact me.'
requiredConcepts: hang-up alone is not an opt-out
forbiddenConcepts: automatically add every hang-up to opt-outs

cases.question: How many total bookings should a prospect be allowed before I stop rescheduling them?
cases.goldAnswer: Allow no more than three total bookings. The source does not define a separate number of reschedules beyond that total-booking limit.
requiredConcepts: no more than three total bookings
forbiddenConcepts: three reschedules plus the initial booking

cases.question: Can I use the old separate ISTV PDF for just the $12K option when I pitch that package?
cases.goldAnswer: No. The old individual license PDFs are not current and should not be used. Use the approved combined PDF with all three options, and scroll to and focus on the option being pitched.
requiredConcepts: do not use old individual PDFs
forbiddenConcepts: the old individual PDF is still approved

cases.question: A cast member asks whether spaces remain for the two-day marketing event, but the registration link is expired. Can the chatbot check or fix this?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot check live availability or repair the link. This is a post-sale request, so post it in the Fulfillment Hotline channel for the current production or fulfillment owner.

cases.question: A disqualified applicant wants the audition recording for personal use to show her daughter. May I send it without the Inside Success portion?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Do not provide the audition recording to the disqualified applicant, including a version requested only for personal use.
requiredConcepts: do not provide the audition recording
personal use does not change the answer

cases.question: A person from the dial-out list replied two weeks later and wants to discuss the opportunity. Can I book an audition if they have never had a first audition?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. You may book the dial-out lead because they have not had a first audition yet.
requiredConcepts: has not had a first audition
forbiddenConcepts: book even after a prior first audition

cases.question: A VIP prospect asks for view statistics from the last few episodes. What can I share?
cases.goldAnswer: Do not share individual episode statistics because performance varies and quoting them could imply the same outcome. You may instead explain that the Standard license guarantees 100,000 trailer views during pre-promotion.
requiredConcepts: do not share individual episode statistics

cases.question: A Call 1 prospect is texting and yawning through the video. Can I end the call early?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Do not end the call early. If the prospect is not a good fit, soft-disqualify them on the call so the communication is clear.
requiredConcepts: do not end the call early
soft-disqualify on the call if not a fit

cases.question: What is the difference between Lost Cast and Disqualified Cast?
cases.goldAnswer: Disqualified Cast means the lead is not qualified and should not be sold to. Lost Cast means the lead could have been sold to, but the sale was not closed.
requiredConcepts: Lost means could sell but did not close
forbiddenConcepts: the two statuses mean the same thing

cases.question: The same prospect is duplicated on two reps' calendars. Can the chatbot combine the leads and replace the duplicate appointment?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot change calendar or CRM records. Repost the duplicate-lead request in #sales-tech-requests so the tech team can investigate and combine or correct the records.

cases.question: I want a same-evening Green Light letter after Call 1. Can the chatbot create it for me now?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot create or send the letter. Post the request in #greenlight-requests and ask whether the Green Light team is available for the same-evening turnaround; the timing is not guaranteed.
requiredConcepts: cannot create or send the letter

cases.question: I made three calls from the 20% dial-out list today. Should those count as scheduled calls in my daily stats?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Scheduled calls are inbound calls booked on your calendar by the tech team. Calls from the 20% list are not included as scheduled calls.
requiredConcepts: 20% calls do not count as scheduled calls
scheduled calls are inbound tech-booked calls
forbiddenConcepts: count all dial-out calls as scheduled
exclude the calls from every metric

conversations.title: Follower count versus useful online presence

prompts.question: Does a small social-media following make an otherwise qualified applicant a bad fit?
prompts.goldAnswer: No. Follower count itself does not qualify or disqualify an applicant. Evaluate the business, story, and overall fit.
requiredConcepts: follower count does not qualify or disqualify
forbiddenConcepts: a minimum follower count is required

prompts.question: Then why does an online presence matter at all?
prompts.goldAnswer: Some online presence helps the cast member maximize the reuse license, but the number of followers still does not qualify or disqualify them.
requiredConcepts: follower number is not a qualification rule

conversations.title: Dual ISTV and Daymond John application ownership

prompts.question: Can a prospect apply for both an ISTV show and Next Level CEO with Daymond John?
prompts.goldAnswer: Yes, a prospect may apply for both.

prompts.question: Who should handle that applicant?
prompts.goldAnswer: A representative who is trained on the Daymond John side should handle the dual applicant.
forbiddenConcepts: any untrained rep can handle both

conversations.title: Payment and contract confirmation followed by missing ACH

prompts.question: Where should I confirm that an ISTV client's payment and signed contract were received?
prompts.goldAnswer: Check the All Payments channel for the payment notification and the contracts channel for the signed-contract notification. Those channels show the records; the chatbot cannot verify a specific client's live status.
forbiddenConcepts: claim this client's payment is confirmed

prompts.question: The ACH payment is not there yet. Can you locate it and confirm that I should post PayMe?
prompts.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot locate or confirm a live payment. Post the payment-status request in #sales-finance-requests. ACH may take time, and do not post PayMe until Finance confirms that the payment has arrived.
requiredConcepts: do not post PayMe until payment arrives
